speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis. The clinical presentation of a pruritic rash, sensory neuropathy (numbness/tingling), hypopigmented macules at the elbows, and alopecia (loss of eyebrows/eyelashes) is highly characteristic of cutaneous leishmaniasis, a parasitic infection likely acquired from your work with livestock.
